scope: Month-by-month 2016 audit of GABAC/GAATC and GARTC minutes. This is an audit only: it does not reverse the pre-existing GARTC routine-minutes exclusions or publish/archival decisions.

source_checks.onbase: Used the City of Albuquerque Public Access Boards and Commissions custom query (ID 136), with committee-name keyword 412 and record-type keyword 413 set to MINUTES. GAATC returned eight 2016 records; GARTC returned the December 20 record only.
source_checks.maintained_city_gartc_page: The City's maintained GARTC Agendas & Minutes page independently lists approved minutes for January through July, October, and December 2016; it has no approved-minutes entries for August, September, or November.
source_checks.inventory: The nine City-linked 2016 GARTC minutes were already retained as source records and excluded as routine minutes in the prior trails-committee review. Eight verified City OnBase GAATC source records were added as pending-review inventory candidates for any future archival decision. Each of the eight GAATC URLs returned HTTP 200 application/pdf in a read-only GET verification.
